insights.title: Extrude the maze distance field into stepwell voxels
insights.body: Distance fields drive 16 sketches, 9 of them the maze-distance glyph series, while heerich has 13 voxel sketches and voxels/wave and voxels/panna-meena already turn a Chebyshev distance into a stepwell. The maze's BFS distance has only ever been coloured or typed, never given height. Feed the sidewinder maze from maze-distance/basic into heerich as column heights, so each distance band becomes one terrace and the solved path reads as a sunken stair.

insights.title: Plot the Hamiltonian one-line as a single pen stroke
insights.body: The nalee-one-line series fills a grid with one Warnsdorff path in 9 sketches, and only 4 of 401 sketches export to the plotter, all of them heerich boxes or the penplot example. A single unbroken path is the one drawing a pen plotter does without lifting, yet every one-line version stays on screen with gradients or neon blur. Port nalee-one-line/albers-meander to penplot: two Hamiltonian paths as two pens, ghost and ink, on an A4 sheet using the export path from voxels/nalee-p.

insights.title: Fill overlapping hulls by XOR parity
insights.body: xor-pattern appears in 11 sketches, 8 of them line fans in Moire and Op Art, while overlap colouring has its own one-offs: boolean/robert-swain inverts intersections and siep-van-den-berg/no-251 shows only where rectangles overlap. The overlapping-hull work (nalee-hulls/i to l, rubber-band-stipple/shape) still paints hulls in stacking order. Rasterise several drifting rubber-band hulls into one XOR buffer, so odd overlaps fill and even ones cancel, and the stack becomes a parity map.

insights.title: Drop the collapsing blinds on springs, not easing
insights.body: Spring physics drives 9 sketches, and red-and-black/spring-anticipation gives vertices a pull-back and overshoot, while the 3 blinds sketches move their rects with plain easing as they fall flush toward the centre. The collapse is a physical event that is currently timed instead of weighted. Fork blinds/collapse-cusp and replace its eased fall with the per-vertex spring and anticipation from red-and-black, so each rect overshoots, settles and seals its lane at its own rate.

insights.title: Shade heerich voxel faces from cusphanger tiers
insights.body: cusphanger feeds 7 sketches, and 4 of those are -cusp forks that only swap a palette, while heerich's 13 voxel sketches shade faces from mix or custom hex. Cusphanger's high, mid and low contrast tiers are a ready three-step light model that no voxel sketch uses. Fork voxels/panna-meena with a cusphanger ground: top faces on the low wash tier, lit sides on mid, shadow sides on high ink, on a P3 canvas.

insights.title: Solve the arc tiles with wave function collapse
insights.body: Wave function collapse appears in 8 sketches, all made on 2024-11-27 and never touched again, and paint-without-thinking runs 11 sketches of Wang arc tiles grown by an edge-matching random walk. Both are edge-constrained tile solvers, but WFC only ever drew pipes and the arc tiles only ever grew by walk. Run the WFC solver from wave-function-collapse/4 over the quarter-arc tile set, then pass the result through the rounded reduction from arcs-reduction-rounded.

insights.title: Place clixo forms by a loom draft, not An+B
insights.body: The 11 clixo sketches place their forms by An+B modulo rules in 9 cases, and anni-weaving has 9 sketches driven by real weave drafts (twill, herringbone, houndstooth, satin, monk's belt). A draft is just a better-structured binary modulo matrix, and clixo has never used one. Fork clixo/criss-cross so the anni-weaving draft decides fill or outline per cell, and the clover forms read as a woven cloth.

insights.title: Grow nalee walkers on a bipolar grid
insights.body: nalee has left the cartesian grid only through polar domains, in 11 polar-grid sketches from nalee/sketches/polar to polar-color-wheel, while the bipolar series draws circle and hyperbola families around two foci in 6 sketches. Bipolar coordinates are still a grid of cells, so the walker can fill them unchanged. Build a bipolar cell domain from bipolar/basic and fill it with pipe walkers, so tube rings crowd toward the two foci instead of one centre.

insights.title: Cast light through a jali screen
insights.body: Raycasting appears in 4 sketches, 3 of them following the mouse among random walls or circles, and the windows-screens thread runs through 9 sketches of jali, khidki and blinds geometry. The screens are drawn as solid lattices and the rays hit nothing but random segments. Use the jali/truchet or nalee-jali/b lattice as the wall set in raycasting/grid and move the emitter on the playhead, so the image is the lit floor pattern the screen throws.

insights.title: Render the WFC pipe networks as glow tubes
insights.body: glow-lines and film-grain each appear in only 3 sketches, all bio-sprue, and the glow-style engine has a single user, while wave-function-collapse/7 fakes a tube by double-drawing each stroke and boids/pipe draws right-angled trails. The neon finish is proven on nalee tubes but has never touched another pipe system. Pass the connected runs of wave-function-collapse/4 through glow-style on a vignetted near-black ground, one hue per component.

insights.title: Draw Chladni nodal lines with field-line ticks
insights.body: The 5 chladni sketches show nodal lines as particles, strokes, trails or ASCII, and electric-field/hatch-field draws a field only as short cross ticks whose length decays with distance, using a spatial hash. Hatching appears in 14 sketches but never on a standing-wave field. Sample the Chladni gradient on the hatch-field grid and draw ticks that shrink toward the nodal lines, so the quiet lines appear as gaps in a black-and-white hatch.

insights.title: Extrude map-maker street blocks with heerich
insights.body: map-maker grows street networks in 3 sketches and heerich builds 13 voxel sketches; both sit in Architectural Space and have never met. The streets are flat lines and the voxel work extrudes only weaves, paths, letters and stepwells. Rasterise the blocks between map/basic's streets onto the heerich grid and give each block a height from its area, so the procedural plan becomes an isometric city.

insights.title: Make the rubber band a real verlet chain
insights.body: rubber-band-stipple has 16 sketches that recompute the band each frame as a hull or tangent path, and 4 soft-body sketches already run verlet spring rings with quadtree collision. The band is called elastic but has no mass, so it never stretches, snaps or lags. Build haberdashery's band as a closed verlet chain from soft-body/verlet-101, wrapped around the same pegs, and let it settle and ripple as the pegs drift.

insights.title: Scope physarum through terminal desktop windows
insights.body: The tui engine has 4 sketches, and terminal-ui/differential-growth uses it as an instrument: one simulation seen through several zoomable windows with a live readout. The 5 physarum sketches and 5 chladni sketches run full-frame with no way to read their state. Run physarum/offscreen's agents behind a desktop of tui windows, one showing the trail buffer, one zoomed on a junction, one printing agent count and sensor angle.

insights.title: Run physarum at a million agents on the GPU
insights.body: Only 4 of 401 sketches use WebGL, all the tensors series with instanced meshes, while physarum/basic steers 16k agents on the CPU and its 5 sketches never grew past that. Slime-mold networks change character with agent count, and the CPU caps the scale. Port physarum/trail's sense-steer-deposit loop to ssam's webgpu mode as a compute pass and render a million agents seeded on the same packed circles.

insights.title: Let differential growth out of its window
insights.body: Differential growth appears once in 401 sketches, inside terminal-ui/differential-growth, where the curve is only seen through glyph-scope windows. The growth lineage (growth, growth-paths, growth-simple) stopped at node accretion in early 2024. Lift the growth-sim module behind the tui sketch into a plain full-frame sketch: one curve grown inside a nalee-style clipped domain and drawn as a single filled band.
